t: Malta Public Transport announces special services for André Rieu concerts
html:
Malta Public Transport will be organising special bus services for the popular André Rieu concerts taking place Friday 29th and Saturday 30th August 2025 at the Granaries in Floriana. The additional services, free for Tallinja Card holders and serving multiple destinations across Malta, are intended to make travel to and from the concerts easier and more convenient for the public.

To make sure that all passengers have the chance to board, buses will remain at the departure point for a short time after the concert ends should there be any delay in the finishing time.  

Passengers are kindly asked to proceed to the departure area promptly once the concert is over to avoid missing their service. Departures will take place once boarding is complete or when required by traffic management.

The usual night routes will continue to operate according to their schedule.

Malta Public Transport invites concertgoers to take advantage of these dedicated services for a smooth journey home. Travel on these services, as well as on the regular night routes, is free of charge for Tallinja Card holders. Passengers without a Tallinja Card may purchase tickets at €3 per trip directly on board, with both cash and contactless payments accepted.

Updates and further information will be available on Malta Public Transport’s website and official social media channels.
